# Digital Hub

> Digital Hub is a digital transformation company founded in 2019 and
> headquartered in New Cairo, Egypt, providing enterprise software, data
> and analytics, AI automation, and technical talent outsourcing to
> government, banking, and enterprise clients.

Digital Hub is a Microsoft Certified Partner and an authorized Nexthink
reseller for Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and North Africa, delivering Digital
Employee Experience (DEX) deployments for banks and telecom operators.

## Services
- [Enterprise Software Solutions](https://digitalhub.com.eg/services/enterprise-software.html)
- [Data & Analytics Solutions](https://digitalhub.com.eg/services/data-analytics.html)
- [AI & Intelligent Automation Solutions](https://digitalhub.com.eg/services/ai-automation.html)
- [Outsourcing Technical Talents](https://digitalhub.com.eg/services/outsourcing.html)
